description: Shows 6 logo previews for a business, made from Anymark's designer templates with the business name set in each: icon logos picked for the business description, and letter logos built on the name's first letter, each with why it fits. Each preview links to the Anymark editor, where the logo can be customized. Previews are not licensed for use until the logo is bought on Anymark. `page` (1-5) shows further previews for the same business.

business_name.description: The name exactly as it should appear on the logo

description.description: What the business does, in a sentence or two

page.description: Which page of previews, 1 by default

name: create_logo_previews
title: Create logo previews
